items.title: Collateral loan kya hai?
items.detail: Property ya FD jaisi cheez security ke taur pe rakhi jaati hai.

items.title: Non-collateral kya hai?
items.detail: Kuch girvi nahi rakhna padta. Lender aapki profile, course aur co-applicant dekhta hai.

items.title: Fark kahan padta hai?
items.detail: Interest rate, loan amount aur approval ki shartein alag hoti hain.

items.title: Pehle kya karein?
items.detail: Kai lenders se offers lo aur sirf rate nahi, total repayment compare karo.

youtube.title: Education loan: collateral vs non-collateral, simple mein
youtube.description:
Education loan do tarah ke hote hain: collateral (security ke saath) aur non-collateral (bina security ke). Dono mein interest rate, loan amount aur approval ki shartein alag hoti hain.

Kai lenders se offers lo aur total repayment compare karo, sirf interest rate nahi.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
